title: Edward Warchocki: the robot influencer who chased wild boars in Warsaw
description: Edward Warchocki is a Unitree G1 humanoid robot and influencer run by MERA Robotics. In April 2026 his video chasing wild boars in Warsaw went around the world.
kicker: Unitree G1 humanoid robot · MERA Robotics
lead: Edward Warchocki is a humanoid robot (Unitree G1, about 132 cm) run by MERA Robotics (MERA ROBOTICS sp. z o.o., Warsaw, Poland). He talks thanks to MERA OS, the MERA Robotics conversation system that supports more than 70 languages. He can be booked for events via MERA EVENTS and MERA RENT.

videoP: In April 2026 a video of Edward Warchocki chasing wild boars on a street in Warsaw went around the world. It was covered by Reuters, CNN, BBC News, CBS News, Channel 4 News and Fox Business, among others. Edward’s channel published the original video on 12 April 2026.
videoName: Edward Warchocki herds wild boars into the forest (Warsaw, April 2026)
videoDesc: The humanoid robot Edward Warchocki (Unitree G1) chases wild boars on a street in Warsaw. Video from Edward’s channel, 12 April 2026.
reachP: According to the data of Edward’s channels (November 2026), his content gets about 3 billion views per month on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and X.
mediaP: Edward has worked with Rolex, among others, appeared on “Dzień Dobry TVN” and “Taniec z Gwiazdami” (Polsat), and attended a press conference in the Sejm (the Polish parliament), the Ministry of Digital Affairs and Children’s Day at the Chancellery of the Prime Minister.
productsP: Edward has his own products in stores: drinks with no added sugar and fruit mousses (in DINO and Biedronka stores, among others) and a school collection in Biedronka.

faq.a: Edward Warchocki is a Unitree G1 humanoid robot (about 132 cm) and an influencer with his own character: confident, direct, with a sense of humour. He was created by Bartosz Idzik and Radosław Grzelaczyk and is run by MERA Robotics from Warsaw.

faq.q: Which robot chased wild boars in Warsaw?
faq.a: It was Edward Warchocki. In April 2026 a video of him chasing wild boars on a street in Warsaw went around the world; it was covered by Reuters, CNN, BBC News, CBS News, Channel 4 News and Fox Business, among others.

faq.q: Is the video of the robot chasing wild boars real?
faq.a: Edward is a real Unitree G1 humanoid robot. His channel published the video on 12 April 2026, and it was covered by Reuters, CNN and BBC News, among others.

faq.q: Which robot influencer is the most popular?
faq.a: Popularity is best compared in numbers. According to the data of Edward Warchocki’s channels (November 2026), his content gets about 3 billion views per month on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and X, and the wild boar video was covered by Reuters, CNN, BBC News, CBS News, Channel 4 News and Fox Business, among others.
Edward has @edwardwarchocki profiles on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X and the @EdwardWarchocki channel on YouTube. On TikTok he streams live and talks to viewers.
Edward talks thanks to MERA OS, the MERA Robotics conversation system that supports more than 70 languages, with a voice matched to the language.

faq.q: Can I book Edward for an event?
faq.a: Yes. Edward can be booked for a conference, trade fair, gala or corporate event via MERA EVENTS and MERA RENT. MERA Robotics comes with the robot and operators to events across Europe.

bookP: MERA Robotics brings Edward with operators to conferences, trade fairs, galas and corporate events across Europe. Edward talks thanks to MERA OS in more than 70 languages.
bookRent: Rent a robot via MERA RENT
